name: diagram-design
description: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: Free plug-in that makes your AI coding assistant draw good-looking, on-brand diagrams — flowcharts, org charts, roadmaps — instead of the generic boxes-and-arrows look most AI tools produce.
buyer: A content marketer, technical writer, or one-person SaaS founder who needs clean diagrams for blog posts, docs, or pitch decks but can't justify a Figma subscription or a designer's time.
business_use_cases: A startup founder writing a 'how it works' blog post asks their AI assistant to generate an architecture diagram that matches their site's brand colors in under a minute.
A consultant preparing a client deck generates a roadmap or Wardley map diagram on the fly during a working session instead of scheduling design time.
A dev-tools company standardizes all its documentation diagrams (sequence, ER, deployment) on this skill so every page in the docs site looks consistent without a design system.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted version that renders these diagram types from a simple web form for non-technical marketers who don't use Claude Code directly.
Sell a premium pack of extra brand themes/templates (e.g. for specific industries) on top of the free open-source skill.

steal_this: Build a tiny web wrapper this weekend: a form where someone pastes their brand colors and picks a diagram type, and it calls this skill's rendering logic to spit out a downloadable SVG — a no-code front end for non-coders.
